values.note: Call, or send the website's reservation-request form ('This is not a Reservation, We will contact you with available sites'; reply normally within 4 hours). Rates are based on 4 people, $10 per extra guest. 14 days' notice for a cancellation; no refunds for leaving early or for weather.

booking.source: http://www.countryvillagerv.com/Contact-Us---Reservations.html + http://www.countryvillagerv.com/Pricing---Polices.html ('All reservations are based on 4 people'; 'Extra Guest $10.00'; cancellation policy), read 2026-10-22

note: Private RV park with rustic cabins and vacation homes at 1200 Country Lane, Ishpeming, within walking distance of stores and restaurants. Large swimming pool, kiddie pool, hot tub, play area, pavilion. Nightly stays sold; weekly/monthly by call. --Claude
summary: Operator site (Homestead) is up; phone (906) 486-0300 matches it and Google Maps (4.3 / 273 reviews). Confirmed 50/30-amp full hookups and phone/request-form booking; added season May 15 - Oct 15 (RV park), camp store, 4-person rate basis. Fees left as recorded (manual 2026-10-19: $65 full / $60 water-electric / $45 rustic-tent; the page is undated). Cleared the derived site count, 40-ft length and pull-through (not stated by the operator; came from directory listings). Note cleaned of hookups/size/season/booking/rating text and the stale 'website unreachable' remark.
flags: Price gate: the operator's daily rates are full hookup $65 and water/electric $60; only 'Rustic / Tent' ($45) is under US$50, and the page does not say whether an RV may use a rustic site. No gateway within 40 km (Pictured Rocks/Munising 80 km); the family has not stayed here. RV Life tier is $$$.

Rates are undated: http://www.countryvillagerv.com/Pricing---Polices.html carries no year, and the site's newest dated content is the 2022 events page (read 2026-10-22). No 2024+ operator date for the $45-65.

Discounts: the reservation form asks for a 'Good Sam Number' and has 'Good Sam Member' and 'Military' checkboxes but states no discount; the entry's derived good_sam: false / military: true were left alone.
